issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 06 requires selecting Gemeinden with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants, but the solution implementation uses the threshold 10,000 (WHERE einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000). This numeric mismatch between specification and solution will confuse students and produce incorrect/contradictory expected results.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the threshold so problem, template hints, and solution agree. Update solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql to use WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000 (or adjust the problem statement to request 10,000 if that was intended). Ensure any tests or example outputs are adjusted consistently.
